STARCH
Cereals, grains, pasta, breads, crackers, snacks, starchy vegeta-
bles, and cooked beans, peas, and lentils are starches. In general, 
1 starch is:
•	
1⁄2 cup of cooked cereal, grain, or starchy vegetable
•	
1⁄2 cup of cooked rice or pasta
•	 1 oz of a bread product, such as 1 slice of bread
•	
3⁄4 oz to 1 oz of most snack foods (some snack foods may 
also have extra fat)
Nutrition Tips
	1.	 A choice on the Starch list has 15 grams of carbohydrate, 
0-3 grams of protein, 0-1 grams of fat, and 80 calories.
	2.	 For maximum health benefits, eat three or more servings 
of whole grains each day. A serving of whole grain is about
